current_state_audit.finding: Payroll, employee directory, and governance summary had zero controls, and filing had only one sidepeek button; rail links to these anchors felt like regressions compared with the dedicated command surfaces.

product_direction_applied.user_directive: Oyatie will build a hyperscaler-grade cloud substrate and dogfood all FD-001 microservices as tenant workloads on that substrate. FD-001 product delivery remains the master-plan product goal; Oyatie Cloud is the substrate that proves the platform can host real production tenants.
product_direction_applied.ui_interpretation: The summary cards now explicitly describe payroll, localization filing, workforce policy, and governance as FD-001/Oyatie Cloud workload proof surfaces, and route into the richer local command areas.

change_summary: Upgraded the Payroll overview card with FD-001/Oyatie Cloud workload copy and local routes to Finance cockpit, Workflow gate, Mail brief, and Evidence.
Upgraded Filing Readiness with Korea localization workload copy and local routes to Billing/Tax, Community council note, and Evidence receipt while preserving sidepeek inspection.
Upgraded Employee Directory with workforce stats and local routes to Identity suite, Onboarding, Policy, and Mail reviewer.
Upgraded Governance Analytics summary with FD-001 workload proof copy and local routes to Governance command, Risk heatmap, Community, and Evidence.
Added shared suite-card selected styling and a data-suite-action interaction handler that routes summary-card actions into existing richer command surfaces instead of duplicating product islands.

differences: Bominal corporate dashboard remains a density and card-language reference; the Oyatie overview cards intentionally route into already-built command surfaces instead of becoming separate standalone apps.
The four overview cards are still summaries, but no longer dead/sparse anchors; they now carry product thesis language and visual local interactions.
The full mockup goal remains active; this evidence proves only the Enterprise Suite overview-card regression gap.
suggestions: Continue final holistic audit for remaining weak anchors such as any no-control subpanels in Policy Access or Audit Ledger before declaring full completion.
If vertical density becomes high, consider card compaction states after mockup fidelity is accepted.
visual_verdict.reasoning: Browser audit before this slice identified four weak overview anchors. Browser smoke after this slice proves every targeted card now has 4 visible buttons except filing with 4 buttons / 3 suite actions, carries FD-001/Oyatie Cloud cohesion copy, and routes to Mail, Onboarding, Billing, and Evidence successfully.

ssr_smoke.note: Initial empty replies can occur during container compile/restart; final response contained the SSR suite-card action markup.
